title: A worker verification's test shards run on ready hosts while a merge trial starts
description: A worker's host-run test check over a large test list, with two ready compute hosts reached through graphyard-host-shim under a strict heavy-job cap of one. Its shards run on both hosts as a merge trial's do, and it holds no heavy-job slot while they run there, so a merge trial takes the one slot at once. Master status's remoteShards shows the worker verification as the latest run, with every shard run remotely and both hosts ready. A check that is one script beside a declared Postgres Compose service has no shards to send: it runs whole on a ready host, which starts the service in its run directory, runs the script on the service's network and removes the project, and it runs on this machine, with the reason in the trial log, when no host is ready or the host drops it. One host serves two installs: each install's key reaches its own release's helper, and removing one install's key leaves the other working. A host that answers without Docker reads away with whether its Docker unit is not enabled or failed. While a leftover limit file fixes the budget and a host is ready, master status names the file, the budget without it and graphyard master config hostHeavyJobs=auto, which removes it.

steps.name: Run a worker verification on two fake hosts and start a merge trial beside it
Show a leftover limit file in master status while hosts are ready, and lift it with hostHeavyJobs=auto
Run a script check and its Postgres service whole on a fake host, and on this machine when the host is away
Read a fake host whose Docker unit is not enabled and one whose unit failed, and show the reason
Prepare one fake host for two installs at different helper releases and probe each through its own helper
